title: Bounded integration budgets for the real world-lease checks
summary: The four multi-transaction world-lease checks receive explicit 60-second budgets, matching the existing actor race. Runtime algorithms, requests, concurrency and assertions are unchanged.
proves: The actual Linux failure is retained: six handovers exceeded the implicit five-second timeout, and the following check encountered the timed-out predecessor’s world. All 21 host tests pass locally with the explicit bounded budgets, with lint/typecheck and generated drift checks green. Linux confirmation remains the conductor’s integration check.

captions.01-linux-failure: Captured Linux failure from run 44014044365: five-second timeout and consequent 409 in the following check.
captions.02-host-suite: The whole real-workerd host suite with explicit lease-test integration budgets.
captions.03-workspace-checks: Nx reset/sync, host lint/typecheck and generation drift check.
